oneParagraphVerdict: The chapter has a usable core: read first-cycle resistance as expected data and convert it into visible adjustment through the cycle and 13th-week review. That idea is memorable and practical enough to retain, but the chapter is not publishable at a professional bar because multiple sections contain unfinished sentences, mismatched names and venues, template residue, and quiz tells. The best lines are strong, but the execution errors are too visible to ship.
